googlebooks-citation-error-no-url: Error message shown when the <googlebooks> tag is used without providing a URL.
googlebooks-citation-error-fetch: Error message shown when the extension cannot fetch the HTML content from the given Google Books URL.
googlebooks-citation-toolbar-button: Label for the Google Books citation button in the editing toolbar.
googlebooks-citation-toolbar-prompt: Prompt text shown when the user clicks the toolbar button, asking for a Google Books URL.
